mapper.select: SELECT R.REQUEST_ID AS requestId, TO_CHAR(R.VISIT_DATE, 'MM.DD HH24:MI') || '~' || TO_CHAR(R.VISIT_DATE + (2/24), 'HH24:MI') AS visitDate, R.ADDRESS || ' ' || R.DETAIL_ADDRESS AS visitAddress, U.USER_NAME AS customerName, R.STATUS AS status FROM REQUESTS R JOIN USERS U ON R.CUSTOMER_NO = U.USER_NO WHERE R.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId}
mapper.update: UPDATE REQUESTS SET STATUS = #{status}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId}
